crossRefs.note: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in…
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,
and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have…
But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret…
